item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"TASK.md\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\",\"policy.json\",\"requests.json\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\np={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}\\ncases=[\\n({'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},'ok'),\\n({'layers':[{'i':None}]},'ok'),\\n({'layers':[{'z':1}]},'unknown_key'),\\n({'environment':{'b':'true','i':'-12','s':''}},'ok'),\\n({'environment':{'b':'TRUE'}},'environment'),\\n({'environment':{'i':'+1'}},'environment'),\\n({'environment':{'i':'01'}},'ok'),\\n({'environment':{'i':' 1'}},'environment'),\\n({'layers':[{'i':False}]},'type'),\\n({'layers':[{'i':'bad'}],'environment':{'i':'3'}},'ok')\\n]\\nfor request,status in cases:\\n r=evaluate(request,p); actual='ok' if r['ok'] else r['error']; assert actual==status,(request,r,status); assert set(r)=={'ok','config','error'}; assert (r['error'] is None)==r['ok']; assert bool(r['config'])==r['ok']\\np_off=dict(p,environment=False)\\nassert evaluate({'environment':{'b':'true'}},p_off)['error']=='environment'\\np_noreset=dict(p,null_resets=False)\\nassert evaluate({'layers':[{'s':None}]},p_noreset)['error']=='type'\\nprint(json.dumps({'independent_boundary_cases':12,'status':'passed'}))\"]}}]}"}
